title: Audio routing policy remediation
summary: Implement verified fixes from the audio routing policy review for default passthrough profile ownership, Python planner/runtime parity, MP4 audio selection, no-audio plan fail-closed behavior, per-file audio override ownership, and stale test expectations.
reason: The audio routing review identified current drift that could force unnecessary transcodes, emit no-audio FFmpeg arguments without the runtime guard, or leave saved audio policy ownership ambiguous.
behavior_before: Packaged Default.psd1 could resolve as a custom codec list, Python channel-cap and MP4 selection logic differed from the PowerShell runtime, plan dry-runs could emit -an when every audio action was dropped, and Python file override validation did not own all audio fields that PowerShell can consume.
behavior_after: Profile-owned default audio codecs are explicit, Python planning mirrors runtime passthrough/channel and MP4 audio ranking behavior, no-audio dry-run command generation fails closed unless allowNoAudio is enabled, per-file audio override fields are validated before save, and tests cover the changed behavior.
